summary: Learn essential IT disaster recovery planning and testing techniques with our comprehensive training program. Prepare your business for any unforeseen event.
lede: IT disaster recovery planning and testing prepares technology services, data, and recovery procedures for disruption. For professionals who plan, operate, or assure technology recovery, the course covers business impact analysis and recovery priorities, mapping service dependencies, and designing exercises to test recovery plans and document follow-up actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, operate, assure, or govern technology recovery capability and need practical evidence of readiness.
prerequisites: You should bring practical knowledge of at least one technology service or operational process. You do not need coding or programming experience. Exercises use instructor-provided recovery scenarios, worksheets, and datasets, so you can complete the course without access to production systems. Advanced cloud recovery, automation, and digital dashboard topics receive operational application treatment rather than technical engineering or production deployment depth.
